objectives: Can name common clothes and accessories
Can ask about price, size, and color
objectivesVi: Có thể gọi tên các loại quần áo và phụ kiện phổ biến
Có thể dùng this/that/these/those để chỉ
Có thể hỏi về giá, kích cỡ và màu sắc

vocab.def: a piece of clothing for the upper body
a piece of clothing covering the legs

vocab.example: I need a hat for the sun.

vocab.cloze: Do you have this in a smaller ___?

vocab.def: the appearance of something (red, blue, etc.)
vocab.cloze: Do you have this in another ___?

vocab.def: to get something by paying money

grammar.explanation: This = cái này (số ít, gần). That = cái đó (số ít, xa). These = những cái này (số nhiều, gần). Those = những cái đó (số nhiều, xa). Dùng để chỉ đồ vật khi mua sắm.
grammar.explanationVi: This = cái này (số ít, gần). That = cái đó (số ít, xa). These = những cái này (số nhiều, gần). Those = những cái đó (số nhiều, xa). Dùng để chỉ đồ vật khi mua sắm.
lines: Those trousers are too long. (far, plural)
commonMistakes: Sai: 'This shoes are nice.' → Đúng: 'These shoes are nice.'
Sai: 'That shirts are expensive.' → Đúng: 'Those shirts are expensive.'
Sai: 'These jacket is nice.' → Đúng: 'This jacket is nice.'

grammar.section: GRAMMAR IN USE · HOW MUCH / HOW MANY
grammar.explanation: How much = bao nhiêu tiền (dùng cho giá cả). How many = bao nhiêu (dùng cho số lượng đếm được). How much is/are = giá bao nhiêu.
grammar.explanationVi: How much = bao nhiêu tiền (dùng cho giá cả). How many = bao nhiêu (dùng cho số lượng đếm được). How much is/are = giá bao nhiêu.
commonMistakes: Sai: 'How much are this shirt?' → Đúng: 'How much is this shirt?'
Sai: 'How many is this?' → Đúng: 'How much is this?'
Sai: 'How much cost this?' → Đúng: 'How much is this?'

dialogue.line: Good morning. Can I help you?
Yes, I'm looking for a shirt.
I like blue. Do you have this in blue?
Yes, we do. Here you are.
That's a bit expensive. Do you have anything cheaper?
This one is on sale. It's 15 dollars.
Great. I'll take it. Thank you.

rolePlay.contextVi: Bạn đang mua quần áo. Hỏi về kích cỡ, màu sắc và giá cả.

reading.title: A Trip to the Market
reading.text: Last Saturday, I went to the market with my friend. The market was very busy. There were many shops selling clothes, shoes, and bags. I wanted to buy a new jacket. I found a nice blue jacket, but it was too expensive. The shop assistant said it was 50 dollars. I looked around and found another jacket. It was on sale for 20 dollars. It was black and the right size. I bought it. My friend bought a pair of shoes. They were cheap and comfortable. We had a great time at the market.

questions.q: What did the person want to buy?
Why didn't they buy the first jacket?
How much was the jacket they bought?

writing.template: I like ___. I need a new ___. This ___ is too ___. I want to buy ___.
checklist: Did you mention at least 2 types of clothes?
Did you mention color or size?

review.summary: In this unit, you learned to talk about clothes, use this/that/these/those, and ask about price, size, and color. Key phrases: 'I'm looking for a...', 'What size/color do you need?', 'How much is it?', 'I'll take it.'
review.summaryVi: Trong unit này, bạn đã học cách nói về quần áo, dùng this/that/these/those, và hỏi về giá, kích cỡ, màu sắc. Cụm từ quan trọng: 'I'm looking for a...', 'What size/color do you need?', 'How much is it?', 'I'll take it.'
